records.title: Qift: Shift-Friendly No-Zero W2 Post-Training Quantization for Rotated W2A4/KV4 LLM Inference
records.reason: The abstract presents post-training low-bit weight/activation/KV quantization for LLM inference, directly targeting memory and computation.

records.title: Accurate Block Quantization in LLMs with Outliers
records.reason: The abstract describes block quantization of LLM weights, activations and KV cache, reducing memory while maintaining inference performance.

records.title: Momentum Transformer: Closing the Performance Gap Between Self-attention and Its Linearization
records.reason: The abstract describes a linearized attention Transformer with linear memory/compute behavior for autoregressive tasks, a directly relevant efficient-attention foundation.

records.title: Exploring Federated Pruning for Large Language Models
records.reason: The arXiv abstract presents federated LLM pruning for privacy-sensitive settings and frames pruning as compression enabling deployment on resource-limited devices.

records.title: Power-Aware Orchestration for Geo-Distributed LLM Inference via Quantum Optimization
records.reason: The worklist provides a stable IEEE DOI and title, but primary abstract retrieval failed. No abstract-based relevance claim is made.

records.title: Mixture-of-Depths Attention
records.reason: The abstract presents hardware-efficient depth attention and reports high FlashAttention2 efficiency at long contexts, directly targeting LLM attention cost.

records.title: Prompt Compression in Production Task Orchestration: A Pre-Registered Randomized Trial
records.reason: The abstract reports a production randomized trial where prompt compression reduces total inference cost, directly relevant to LLM systems.

records.title: RACE Attention: A Strictly Linear-Time Attention Layer for Training on Outrageously Large Contexts
records.reason: The abstract presents a strictly linear-time attention layer with reduced time/memory and high throughput for very long contexts; this is a reusable efficient-attention method linked to inference systems.

records.title: Autoregressive Models Rival Diffusion Models at ANY-ORDER Generation
records.reason: The abstract introduces any-order autoregressive generation with two-stream attention, but does not establish an inference-efficiency or systems-performance gain; retain as a generation architecture with a limited efficiency connection.

records.title: CLEAR: Conv-Like Linearization Revs Pre-Trained Diffusion Transformers Up
records.reason: The abstract applies linearized attention to image-generation diffusion Transformers; the independent image-generation application has no direct LLM inference connection.

records.title: Performance Aware LLM Load Balancer for Mixed Workloads
records.reason: The official Microsoft Research publication abstract describes phase-aware workload routing across LLM instances and reports lower end-to-end inference latency.

records.title: UniMem: Towards a Unified View of Long-Context Large Language Models
records.reason: The abstract concerns long-context LLM memory and introduces a unified memory view, but the evidence retrieved does not establish a concrete inference-efficiency benefit.

records.title: LinRec: Linear Attention Mechanism for Long-term Sequential Recommender Systems
records.reason: The abstract applies linear attention to sequential recommender systems; this is a separate recommendation application with no direct LLM inference/system connection.

records.title: A JoLT for the KV cache: Near-Lossless KV Cache Compression via Joint Rank-bit Allocation
records.reason: The arXiv abstract for arXiv:2607.12550 confirms same work under a revised title and proposes near-lossless KV-cache compression with rank/bit allocation, directly relevant to LLM inference memory.

records.title: TransMLA: Migrating GQA Models to MLA with Full DeepSeek Compatibility and Speedup
records.reason: The official OpenReview conference abstract describes migrating GQA to MLA for large KV-cache compression and serving speedups; the stable DOI/worklist record resolves to this paper.

records.title: Learning What Matters: Supervising Global Context Pruning with Causal Evidence Sets
records.reason: The official arXiv record under the same candidate work identifies a title revision; its abstract evaluates sparse context pruning and causal-evidence routers that improve long-context inference routing.

records.title: SDSAT: Accelerating LLM Inference through Speculative Decoding with Semantic Adaptive Tokens
records.reason: The abstract describes semantic-adaptive speculative decoding for LLM inference and reports more than 3x speedup.

records.title: Scaling Speculative Decoding with Lookahead Reasoning
records.reason: The abstract adds step-level parallelism to speculative decoding and reports inference speedups, directly relevant to efficient LLM generation.

records.title: Past- and Future-Informed KV Cache Policy with Salience Estimation in Autoregressive Video Diffusion
records.reason: The abstract proposes a KV-cache policy for autoregressive video diffusion inference, but application is video-generation rather than LLM; retain as a neighboring cache-management method with limited transfer evidence.

records.title: SATORU: Proactive Length-Aware Scheduling for High-Throughput Batch LLM Serving
records.reason: The official CLOSER program abstract describes length-aware within/across-instance LLM serving scheduling using KV-cache lookahead and reports throughput gains with low scheduling overhead.
